history.notes: First release: accounts, library, trainings, readings, labs.
Sections by type, videos, other materials, pack specs (stlp create).
Lab source files, compact lab header.
SemiTec Academy, .stlp packages, Markdown readings and materials.
Library search and filters, enrollment and study plans (package schedule), calendar, Today panel, projects, certificates.
Dashboard, catalog (folders and catalog links), publishers with logos, materials attached to labs ("for"), project categories, user and application settings.

Prerequisites ("prerequisite": true): optional refreshers shown before the course, not counted. Attached materials ("for") no longer count in progress. Reset progress of a package (pack page, or when removing it from My packages).
Locally trusted publisher keys, publisher feedback contact, optional package certificates, and clearer independent project plans.
Projects follow My packages; removing a package stops its active plans after confirmation and clears stale plan references on sign-in.
Package format 2 adds a publisher-defined, accessible accent style for package details and non-training material views.
Training format 2 is a self-contained custom web training: local HTML, CSS and JavaScript run in a sandboxed iframe and use the Academy bridge to save progress.

Package format 3 adds an optional per-package password gate. Learners can export local package files; JSON trainings export as a standalone HTML file and custom web trainings export as their local folder.
Two training formats: JSON and custom web, optional HTML certificates, manual progress, full-folder exports and mandatory course order and study plan.
After preview-password approval, Academy opens an all-sections author preview for trainings; normal tracked study remains separately available.
